rules.text: You can return items with the original receipt within 30 days of purchase for a refund or replacement.
rules.quote: simply return with the original receipt within 30 days of the purchase date for a refund or replacement.

rules.category: performance accessories, electrical items, electronics, and tire chains
rules.text: Installed performance accessories, electrical items, electronics, and tire chains cannot be returned.
rules.quote: If installed, performance accessories, electrical items, electronics, and tire chains cannot be accepted for return

rules.text: Opened or consumed products cannot be returned.
rules.quote: Opened or consumed products cannot be accepted for return

rules.text: Clearance merchandise is not eligible for return.
rules.quote: Clearance merchandise is not eligible for return

rules.category: special order merchandise, uninstalled tires and uninstalled tire chains
rules.text: Special order merchandise, uninstalled tires and uninstalled tire chains are subject to a 20% restocking fee if returned.
rules.quote: Special Order merchandise, uninstalled tires and / or uninstalled tire chains will be accepted for return subject to a 20% restocking fee

rules.text: A 20% restocking fee applies to cancellations and certain returns.
rules.quote: We will process your refund and credit the payment card you used to place the order in the amount of your order, less the 20% restocking fee.
rules.reviewNote: The summary generalizes the 20% restocking fee to 'cancellations and certain returns,' but the quote only mentions it being deducted from the refund amount, not specifically for cancellations.

rules.text: Returns without a receipt are accepted for in-store credit at the lowest selling price in the last 30 days with valid ID.
rules.quote: If you do not have your receipt, you may return your purchase for an in-store credit at our lowest selling price during the previous 30 days. You will need to provide a valid form of identification to return an item without a receipt.

rules.text: If you paid by check, returns are not accepted until 15 days after purchase.
rules.quote: If you paid by check we unfortunately cannot accept your return until the 15th day after the date of purchase.

rules.text: Refunds may take up to ten business days to appear on your account due to credit card company regulations.
rules.quote: Please note that it may take up to ten business days for the credit to appear on your account, due to credit card company regulations.

rules.text: Installed tires have a 30-day or 1,000-mile satisfaction guarantee allowing exchange for better suited tires.
rules.quote: Pep Boys offers a 30-days or 1,000-mile satisfaction guarantee on Pep Boys installed tires. If you are not 100% satisfied with your new tires, we will exchange them for tires better suited for your needs.

rules.text: Batteries, alternators, and starters can be exchanged if verified defective via in-store testing within warranty period.
rules.quote: Batteries / Alternators / Starters – eligible for exchange if verified defective via Pep Boys’ in-store testing within warranty period
